title: Littles Love Learning - Videos
description:
Hi! I'm Erin, an experienced teacher & reading specialist documenting my journey as a first year literacy interventionist in 2nd & 3rd grade. This channel is where I share what I'm learning, what's working (and what's not!), and the resources I'm creating along the way.

Rather than pretending to have all the answers, I'm sharing what I'm learning in real time to hopefully help you on your journey, too! Here you'll find:

❤️Weekly reflections from life as a literacy interventionist
🧡Practical literacy strategies and intervention ideas
💛Book recommendations and professional learning
💚Behind-the-scenes planning and organization
💜Honest conversations about the challenges and successes of supporting striving readers
🩷And so much more!

Whether you're preparing for your first year in intervention, looking for practical literacy ideas, or simply enjoy learning alongside other educators, I hope you'll find encouragement and inspiration here!
